caption: The drawing depicts a round plate with a decorative design featuring a central bird, possibly a peacock, facing left. The bird is rendered in shades of green with orange details on its wing and body, and its tail feathers are elongated and composed of crosshatched lines. To the bird's left, there is a large flower with orange petals and green stem and leaves. To the right of the bird is a spiky flower or sun-like shape in orange with a crosshatched center and green leaves curving upward. Several smaller green leaves and stems are scattered throughout the design. The background of the plate is a gradient of yellow, green, and light brown, and the border contains a repeating pattern of curved brown lines. Near the bottom edge of the plate inside the border, the numbers "1812" and the letters "R. G." are visible, inscribed in brown. The overall color palette includes shades of brown, green, yellow, and orange.
title: Pa. German Plate
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
